name: CubeSmart on Manuel Drive
summary: CubeSmart at 219 Manuel Drive lists heated-and-cooled and drive-up rooms. Drive-up means you can park at the door. Checked Nov 24, 2026, on Storage.com, a climate 5x10 is $57.60 online and $96 in the store, under first month free and 40% off. Storage.com lists a $29 admin fee. CubeSmart's own page did not open. Ask how many months the discount lasts before you budget it.
